sourceConflictNote: The bilingual OKCPS calendar has three internal inconsistencies. The English summary lists 169 Student Days, while the Spanish summary lists 168 because its second-quarter figure is 38 instead of 39. The No School table says Winter Break runs through January 5, 2027, while the grid also places the third-quarter opening marker on January 5; January 5 remains a no-school date and January 6 is listed as the return. The Admin Building Closings table labels September 1 as Labor Day, while the grid and No School table mark September 7. Structured dates use the English Student Days row, the full break range and the September 7 holiday.
schoolHoursSourceConflictNote: Willow Brook Elementary's homepage lists 7:50 a.m.–3:00 p.m., while its General Information page lists 8:10 a.m.–3:20 p.m. The school-specific time remains unresolved and is not normalized into the districtwide hours table.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Oklahoma City Public Schools start in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: OKCPS classes begin Tuesday, August 11, 2026. Teacher work and professional-development days run before students begin.

calendarFaqs.q: When do OKCPS students return after Winter Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The No School table lists Winter Break through January 5, so January 6 is the first weekday after the published break. We list January 6 as the student return date but note that OKCPS does not print it as a separate event.

calendarFaqs.q: When are OKCPS parent conferences in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The calendar lists September 22 and 24, 2026, and February 8 and 11, 2027. Those dates are not separately listed as no-school days. Contact the student's school for the appointment time.

calendarFaqs.q: How many Student Days are on the OKCPS 2026–27 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The English summary lists 169 Student Days: 42, 39, 46 and 42 by quarter. The Spanish summary on the same bilingual sheet lists 168 because its second-quarter figure is 38. For planning, we use the English total and note the discrepancy.

calendarFaqs.q: Is April 16, 2027 a school day in OKCPS?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar lists April 16 as a Snow Day in the No School column, while the grid marks it as a Teacher Work Day. For students, it remains a no-school date.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for OKCPS in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of classes is Thursday, May 20, 2027. Friday, May 21 is a Record Day for staff and is not a student class day.

calendarFaqs.q: Where is the official OKCPS 2026–27 PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: The district currently links to a view-only Google Sheet rather than a PDF. The official sheet is linked in Download Options.
